facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, freely; convert and transfer at market rates.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Yes: hold foreign-currency deposits, with no limit on accounts.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Local banks like TBC and Bank of Georgia offer acquiring; not researched.
facts.L1_registration: Register as an Individual Entrepreneur, then apply for Small Business Status on rs.ge.
facts.L2_tax_id: A permanent ID number, assigned when you register.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Small Business Status: 1% of turnover up to GEL 500,000.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 18% VAT above GEL 100,000 in any 12 months.
facts.L5_data_protection: Personal Data Protection Law 2023, GDPR-aligned, now overseen by the State Audit Office.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Online consumer protection law exists; refund rules not confirmed yet.
facts.L7_incentives: 1% Small Business tax, and micro-businesses under GEL 30,000 are tax-exempt.

watch_out.text: Consulting is excluded from the 1% regime; check your activity code.
Work done in Georgia for foreign clients still counts as Georgian income.
